messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered: P1 - APIGW 5xx spike across edge/gateway — INC-8742. Notifying oncall.
pagerduty: ✋ paging oncall-jess
oncall-jess: I'm on it. Seeing alert flood. Who's seeing user impact? @customer-success-lin?
mike: Oncall-mike here. Pulling dashboards now.
sara: Grafana shows 502/504s jump at 14:12 UTC. Error-rate ~18% across us-east-1 and eu-west-1; latency p95 climbing from 120ms -> 900ms.
ops-lead-raj: Any recent deploys or config changes in last 15m?
net-eng-amy: No deploys. Flow logs show increased retransmits to upstream pool 10.12.0.0/24 and elevated TCP RSTs from cloud-lb.
customer-success-lin: Got inbound tickets from 6 customers, mostly embed/generate endpoints timing out. No major outage claimed yet but degraded UX.
oncall-jess: Ok. Mike/Sara, triage options: scale gateways, activate circuit-breaker, or route to secondary region. Thoughts?
mike: I'll start scaling apigw pool and add ephemeral nodes. Command:
```
kubectl -n prod scale deploy/apigw --replicas=40
```
sara: Also suggest enabling fallback routing to a lower-latency model variant and bump request timeout 3s -> 8s for impacted routes to reduce 504 noise.
net-eng-amy: I'm checking edge peers. Looks like a transient network path issue from provider to our edge LBs. Opening provider ticket now.
oncall-jess: @eng-sre-team can someone run quick health checks on model-router and auth services?
eng-sre-team: Running checks...
eng-sre-team: model-router OK but p95 at ~500ms; auth healthy. So upstream is slower but not fully failing.
mike: Scaling started (initiated by mike at 14:18 UTC). Adding 10 nodes now.
incident-bot: Note: scaling action recorded (user:mike) at 1769123899
sara: Rolling out routing change: set fallback=true and disable streaming for heavy routes. Command:
```
redwoodctl config set routing.fallback.enabled=true --scope=apigw
redwoodctl config set streaming.enabled=false --route=/v1/generate
```
oncall-jess: Applied fallback at 14:27 UTC. Observability link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/edge/apigw?orgId=1&from=1769120400&to=1769124000
incident-bot: Alert: error-rate decreased from 18% -> 6% within 5m of fallback activation.
net-eng-amy: Provider confirmed a transient networking throttling event; they pushed a routing fix at 14:30 UTC and claim propagation should finish in 10-20m.
mike: Scaling finished. New nodes show low CPU but network error counts still elevated on some LBs.
customer-success-lin: Sending templated customer message with incident ID INC-8742 and "we're mitigating" note. ETA 30m.
oncall-jess: Summary for now: - Peak error-rate ~18% 502/504s; affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/embed - Mitigation: fallback routing -> lower-latency model variant, increased timeouts, disabled streaming on heavy paths, scaled apigw pool, provider routing fix in progress.
ops-lead-raj: Please add logs and timeline to the incident doc. We'll produce a postmortem once stable.
sara: I'll keep traffic shifts gradual. Plan: monitor for 15m stable window, then roll traffic back 10% increments.
oncall-jess: Handing off monitoring to SRE rotation (mike -> jess). I'll remain available for escalation. Closing live triage but keeping thread open for updates.
customer-success-lin: CS will follow up with affected customers with interim remediation steps.
eng-sre-team: Adding flags to incident doc: suspected provider network flapping; fallback mitigations worked; further follow-up required on edge LB health checks.
net-eng-amy: Provider's ticket: #PV-9923. I'll paste trace links into the incident doc.
oncall-jess: Thanks everyone. Tagging for postmortem: @ops-lead-raj, @net-eng-amy, @sara, @mike, @customer-success-lin. Will schedule RCA once we confirm stability.
incident-bot: Incident INC-8742 moved to "mitigated" at 1769123620
